lessons_used: Predictions are often higher than noise-corrected results, though several smaller predictions underestimated actual gains.
No clear effect was seen for home, wait_info changes across four tests.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path, hint changes across two tests.
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes remains thin because results contradict each other across three tests.
Evidence for sign_in, copy changes is still thin because one test won while the other showed no clear effect.
Evidence for adoption, finish, choose_path layout, and home notification changes remains thin with only one test per specific change type.

candidates.title: Interactive pet controls tutorial screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates how to summon, dock, and hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8% with long completion times.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_controls_tutorial']

candidates.title: Redesign photo upload with live avatar preview stage
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a stage layout featuring a live rendered preview component so users verify avatar output before finalizing.
candidates.why: Adoption has high median time (89s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or incorrect pet appearance.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the photo upload screen with live preview.

candidates.score_note: Addresses photo upload failures (3 emails) and high adoption drop-off; adoption redesign previously yielded +9.2%.

candidates.title: Move sign-in after waiting screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen after the desktop waiting screen so authentication occurs right before final launch.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off remains high (23.1% loss) and moving account creation after the pet engine finishes initializing ensures setup completes seamlessly.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step after waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step loses 23.1% of users, but sign_in reorders consistently showed no clear effect (-0.1% over 3 tests).

candidates.title: Desktop placement verification interactive flow
candidates.change: Introduce a desktop visibility verification step during waiting with an interactive button to confirm pet overlay rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pet overlay missing from desktop or app failing to display after onboarding completion.

guard.reason: Valid update to waiting screen with desktop placement verification.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 3 support tickets regarding desktop overlay visibility, but requires a whole new verification screen.

candidates.title: Existing pet recovery sign-in notice
candidates.change: Add reassuring copy explaining that signing into an existing account immediately restores saved pets and custom settings.
candidates.why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Pet
sign_in.body: Existing pet owners: log in with your primary account to automatically retrieve your pet, traits, and saved progress.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for existing pet recovery on sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme (8 emails) and high sign-in drop-off; low-cost copy fix backed by prior +2.6% win.

candidates.title: Starter care package finish incentive
candidates.change: Display a starter care kit announcement component on the home intro screen to motivate completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 23.0% and the finish step loses 35.2% of remaining users.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('Free Starter Care Kit').

candidates.title: Story screen companion teaser hint
candidates.change: Display a hint on the story screen describing how desktop pets interact directly with desktop windows and system tray.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion about pet behavior.

story.hint: Your desktop companion live-animates across your open windows and docks in your system tray.

guard.reason: Valid addition of companion teaser hint to story screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets 23.8% drop-off at choose_path, but hints on this step showed negative results (-0.6% across 2 tests).

candidates.title: Background desktop engine setup progress details
candidates.change: Provide detailed status text on the waiting screen explaining background window anchoring and engine initialization.
candidates.why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and 3 users reported desktop launch issues.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Engine
waiting.body: Configuring window transparency and anchoring your pet to your screen...

guard.reason: Valid status information update on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 2336s wait time and 3 emails, but 4 previous wait_info tests showed negligible gain (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Audio cue on pet initialization ready
candidates.change: Play a subtle audio notification chime when the pet engine finishes loading on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High waiting mean duration (2336s) indicates users switch tasks or step away while the app initializes.

guard.reason: Valid addition of completion audio notification on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Aims to help long home wait times, but home notification tests previously resulted in a -2.0% drop.

candidates.title: Grid layout for story introduction
candidates.change: Switch the story screen layout to a structured grid to present key desktop pet features upfront.
candidates.why: Choosing a path takes a mean of 514s with 76.2% conversion; a structured layout speeds up feature understanding.

guard.reason: Valid grid layout redesign for story screen.

candidates.score_note: Helps users scan features faster during 514s choose_path step; prior layout test showed +2.3%.
